title: Basic Prompt Structure
content: Learn to create effective prompts with clear instructions, context setting, output format specification, and examples/templates

title: Clear Instructions
content: Provide explicit, unambiguous instructions to guide the LLM's response

title: Context Setting
content: Include necessary context for the LLM to understand and solve the problem effectively

title: Output Format Specification
content: Clearly specify the desired output format. Example: 'Provide results in a table with columns: ID, Name, Date, Location, Dollar Amount. Do not include any other columns'

title: Examples and Templates
content: Upload templates and provide examples of desired responses. Use increased specificity as a second step if initial results are unsatisfactory

title: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
content: Prompt the LLM to show its work or explain reasoning steps. Example: 'show the steps you used to arrive at this response' or 'break down the problem'

title: Role-Based Prompting
content: Define a scenario where the LLM's role, knowledge level, and interaction context are clear. Example: 'You are a high-level IT manager reviewing project updates. You prefer concise, value-driven updates with attention to blockers'

title: Few-Shot Learning
content: Provide examples of desired results alongside instructions to guide the LLM. Helpful for precisely formatted results and specific field extraction

title: Iterative Refinement
content: Use domain knowledge and prompting techniques to guide and refine the LLM's response through subsequent prompts. Adjust context, provide corrections, or request query restatement

title: Data Privacy and Security
content: Understand what data AI systems can access, confidentiality considerations, and regulatory compliance requirements in financial services

title: AI Access Controls
content: Learn which data AI systems can and cannot access within your organization

title: Confidentiality Considerations
content: Understand how to protect sensitive information when using AI tools

title: Regulatory Compliance
content: Financial industry-specific regulations governing AI usage and data handling

title: Bias and Fairness
content: Understand how AI can perpetuate biases, the importance of diverse training data, and validation approaches

title: AI Bias Sources
content: Learn how AI systems can perpetuate existing biases from training data

title: Diverse Training Data
content: Understand why diverse and representative training data is crucial for fair AI outcomes

title: Validation and Testing
content: Learn approaches for validating AI outputs and testing for bias and fairness

title: How LLMs Work
content: Understand LLM fundamentals: training on vast text data, pattern recognition and prediction, limitations and hallucinations

title: LLM Training Process
content: LLMs learn from vast amounts of text data to recognize patterns and relationships

title: Pattern Recognition
content: LLMs identify and use patterns in text to generate predictions and responses

title: LLM Limitations
content: Understand that LLMs can produce hallucinations (false information) and have knowledge cutoffs

title: Text Generation and Completion
content: LLMs can generate new text or complete partial text based on context and patterns

title: Summarization and Analysis
content: LLMs can summarize and analyze content from various file types and documents

title: Translation and Formatting
content: LLMs can translate between languages and reformat content to desired structures

title: Question Answering
content: LLMs can answer questions based on their training or provided context

title: AI vs ML vs Deep Learning
content: Understand the differences: AI (broad field), Machine Learning (learning from data), Deep Learning (neural networks). Explained with financial industry analogies

title: What is AI
content: Artificial Intelligence: systems that can perform tasks requiring human-like intelligence

title: What is Machine Learning
content: ML: systems that learn and improve from data without explicit programming

title: What is Deep Learning
content: Deep Learning: advanced ML using neural networks with multiple layers

title: AI vs Traditional Software
content: AI systems learn from data and adapt, unlike traditional rule-based software

title: AI in Investment Management
content: Why AI is relevant and transformative for investment management and financial services

title: Generative AI
content: AI systems that create new content (text, images, code) based on learned patterns
